about: GitHub accounts whose own merges into main the owner approves for publication (scripts/release-approval.mjs). Matched by immutable user id. A listed maintainer's merge does not count when it changes sdk/approvals/ or the release gate itself; those need the owner's merge.

maintainers.ownerStatement: "I approve all merges by npp1993, he is a collaborator and maintainer" (26 November 2026), after the release gate held back the publication of #2111 because npp1993 had merged #2206 himself.
